NARROW, as MB98a: pinned to the creature's own planet, so the words name the creature and the planet aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).

STAND-INS, two: (1) the target. Searched 11-02 (gen_inspect Npc 'Mauler', 'RedMile', 'Porrima'): only tankgirlsxenologyexpanded.esm's TG_OutpostClone_RedMileMauler, a third-party mod we must not depend on. The vanilla Mauler's EditorID does not carry its name; Eliza's or his. (2) place.planet 'Porrima III' is not in the closed table yet.

place._theme: A quiet site on Porrima III, home of the Red Mile.

prose.name: Hunt: Red Mile Maulers on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Three Red Mile Maulers have settled in around the <Place>, and Maulers don't move on once they've settled. Porrima answers to neither the Collective nor the UC, so nobody else is coming. The site wants all three put down.
prose.card: Three Red Mile Maulers have settled round the <Place>, and Maulers don't move on. Nobody else is coming. All three, please.

broadcast: Up at the Red Mile, people pay to be chased by these. Out here we just want them gone. They come in threes and settle close, so find one and you've found the other two. Take them one at a time if they let you.
